points.reason: The cascade-spring secret door (and its return maps.txt:548:return:whitehorn_range_secrets->whitehorn_range, same authored tile) stands on the 1.3-grade slope under Landmark_frozen_cascade_01, beside the colliding Secret_horn_cascade_spring prop; its only walkable ground within 5 m is a 23-tile shelf of the cascade seat. A cutting that brings reach within 5 m would lower the ground under the spring prop by up to 3 m, so both records are pinned 7 m south at the foot of the slope on the reached cascade basin.

Return of the Tower 3 door, inside the tower's box; pinned 4 m south to the tower's south ledge (85 m) beside the door's pin.

points.reason: The wisp focus door stands on a 13-tile ledge at 101-103 m on Tower 3's east flank that no link reaches; pinned 12 m south to the tower's south ledge (89.5 m), the nearest reachable ground at the foot of that flank, clear of Shrine 2 and Tower 3.

Door 477 (with its return maps.txt:492 and interactive 506, same authored tile) stands at (577.9, 693.0) on a 1.2-grade bank below Watchtower_2; the only reached ground within its 5 m budget lies inside Watchtower_2's box, so it is pinned 9 m down its own door road to the open bridge terrace at the foot of the bank.

Ridge shrine insides door stands on the summit shelf (43 m) that no served ground reaches: its only access, Landmark_Stair_summit_climb, has no walk deck over ground steeper than .65 and, like the huts and props on the shelf, is a temple-summit compound member no link may regrade. Pinned to the temple terrace at the foot of the shelf's west flank (34 m), 13.2 m west-south-west, outside the Great Temple and summit stair boxes.

Return of the ridge shrine insides door (maps.txt:353) on the same unreachable summit shelf; pinned 2 m west of the door's pin on the temple terrace at the foot of the west flank (34 m), 13.2 m from its entrance, keeping the original pair's 2 m spacing.

Quarry pit secret door, its return (maps.txt:376) and bound interactive share this tile on the summit shelf's north-west rim (45 m), a 15-tile island among temple-summit compound members. Pinned to the reached ground at the foot of the rim north of the Great Temple's terrace (32.6 m), 11.6 m west-south-west, 1 m outside the temple's box.

Culvert secret door, its return (maps.txt:383) and bound interactive share this tile, 0.2 m from Ruin_boundary_shrine_03 on the summit's north flank (27.5 m, grade above 1). Pinned to the reached river terrace at the foot of that flank (15 m), 8.9 m north-north-east, beside the Marchstone Hermit, where a culvert would outlet.

East lookout secret door, its return (maps.txt:379) and bound interactive share this tile at the lookout butts on the steep slope south of Landmark_EastLookout (33.6 m), no walkable tile within 5 m. Pinned to the reached ground at the foot of that slope (20 m), 9.2 m north-east, outside the lookout's and the Upper Court arcade's boxes.

Ridge reliquary secret door, its return (maps.txt:380) and bound interactive share this tile on the 20 m river face below the ridge shrine (31 m), a 1-tile ledge. Pinned to the reached riverside path at the foot of the face (13.7 m), 12.6 m south.

Massif reliquary secret door, its return (maps.txt:722) and bound interactive share this tile on a 6-tile ledge 7 m above the Field Station yard, 0-2 m from the massif crystal spires. Pinned to the yard below the ledge (17.2 m), in the passage east of Landmark_FieldStation_4 (0.8 m outside its box), 8.4 m south-south-east.
the gauntlet entrance stands on a 1-4 m strip at 121-125 m on the barrow court east face; its arrival is pinned to the reached court below
the gauntlet keeper stands beside the pinned gauntlet arrival on the reached court below the entrance strip

Door 482, its return maps.txt:491 and interactive 512 share authored tile [187, 385] (one pin serves all three): the warm-spring door stands at (525.9, 444.6) on a 15-tile ledge about 49 m up the cliff north of the canopy village, unreachable by any grade; pinned 14.4 m south, straight below it, on the reach link reach3-amberwood-1 shelf at the cliff foot.

The undercut mouth door 775, its return maps.txt:778 and interactive 512 share authored tile [342, 332]: the mouth stands in a 4-tile pocket at 147 m on a 45-degree face below Tower 4 that the seventeenth landform left unreachable (the sixteenth seated it in place). Round-four trail designs failed: the barrow lowland's 8 m step to the Barrow 4 terrace has 7-9 m of room between Barrow 1, the barrow well and the lowland's only connection strip, and the 15 m face above has no bench to turn on. Relocation found no bank nearer than 38 m. Pinned at the foot of the slope straight below the mouth (33.6 m, 28 m lower), where its discovery trail already starts, 7 m east of the barrow well door. Its roads stay on the entrance ("roads": "entrance"): routed to this pin the discovery trail vanished and the Grey Moors roads settled differently, cutting 49 barrow-country records off (bake 9).

One of five invasion spawn points of a single wave cluster, authored within 5 tiles of each other ([401, 401], [403, 403], [405, 401], [403, 406], [406, 404]) and served together on one tile by the sixteenth publication. On the seventeenth composition this point follows a different retained anchor than the other four and lands 169 m north-east of them (expected (581.5, 492.9), beyond its 80 m budget of the cluster), so the placement split the shared tile, which the publication rebase keyed by served tile cannot express. Pinned with its cluster on the tile the other four share.

Return of glacier temple door maps.txt:515, authored 2 tiles west of its door. The owner's object edit moved Landmark_shrine_02 (with the shrine school) 286 m south; the door is linked to the shrine and followed it to (538.5, 386.5), but the return is not linked and stayed at the old site, 31.8 m from the mine portal, so leaving the temple put the player 288 tiles from the door they entered (the live fixture audit refused the round trip). Pinned beside the moved door at the offset the other temple returns keep (2 tiles west, 1 north); roads stay on the entrance so the road network is unchanged.

hullSettle.policy: Rigid translation: afloat on the actual water surface with a complete navigable footprint, moored at the water line with the hull edge against the bank when most of the footprint is water, otherwise hauled up on the ground; a hull hauled up across a slope moves to the nearest spot within 12 m where it floats level, if one exists; companions within a hull footprint follow it; gameplay-linked hulls untouched.

roadGradingPasses.exceptions: Original drainage beds and surveyed assembly support remain authoritative; exported collision and bridge tests verify actual traversability.

resourceTrails.policy: A harvest node or territory marker on ground steeper than .65 across a station, with most ground within its 35 m budget as steep and no road station within 30 m, gets a 1.65 m trail from the nearest road station of its territory to its cluster; an NPC post with a station within 30 m but none within its 12 m budget nor within .65 of its height across the gap gets one whatever its ground, and a post with no station within 30 m follows the site rule; clusters join sites within 20 m.

riverCrossings.rule: Roads cross plan rivers only at claimed sites; river water and its setback are impassable elsewhere.

routing.policy: River water and its setback (max(6 m, half width + 4 m)) are impassable for every alignment and edge; a plan river is crossed only on a bridge edge between the routed landings of a crossing site (river_crossings.py), which the road then claims; retained solids up to 1600 square metres, widened by 2 m, are impassable for alignments and their edges except the solids within 6 m of a road end, first at 6 m stations then at 4 m; a road end inside a solid starts or ends with a close-station leg from open ground; a sealed end falls back to solids as a heavy penalty; larger boxes keep the soft clearance penalty; the seam-terminal term stands at its listed weight; the cross-slope, relief and step-grade terms stand at their listed module weights (zero: off) except in the territories listed under terrainTermsByTerritory.
